title: Efficient bimetallic metal–organic framework derived magnetic Co/N-PC-800 nanoreactor for peroxymonosulfate activation and carbamazepine degradation
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EN00898G, Paper
Qiao-Qiao Huang, Yu-Mei Wang, Xun Fu, Xiao-Li Hu, Jia-Wei Wang, Zhong-Min Su
Co/N-PC-T (600, 700, 800, 900) were successfully obtained by calcining the precursor Co@Zn-MOF, and Co/N-PC-800 exhibited excellent peroxymonosulfate activation for CBZ, achieving 98% degradation within 30 minutes.
